# Tagcast 1.4.0 — In your language

Tagcast is now available in **English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish and Japanese**.
This update also adds an optional spinning CD view and improves the sidebar and
player's visual clarity. All features from 1.3.0 remain included, including online
lyrics, custom themes, the Mini Player and reviewed uploads and downloads.

## Choose your language

Use the subtle globe and language code in the header, or **Settings → Interface →
Language**. Languages are listed by their own names. **Auto** follows the system;
an explicit choice is remembered across restarts in the browser or desktop profile.
You can change language without restarting playback or replacing the queue.

Navigation, browsing, the metadata editor, reviews, Settings, contextual help,
lyrics controls and desktop menus use the shared translation system. Counts,
dates and numbers follow the chosen locale. Music titles, artist names, genres,
tags and other stored metadata are never translated or rewritten.

Open dialogs with unsaved work retain their existing language until reopened, so
switching language does not discard drafts. Some server/provider errors and online
source text remain English or use the source's original language. Auto can select a
supported system language on existing installations; choose English explicitly if
you prefer to keep it. Translation coverage is checked automatically, but wording
feedback from native speakers is welcome.

## A CD view for Now playing

Choose **CD view** in expanded Now playing, or **Settings → Playback → Now playing
artwork → Spinning CD**. The album artwork becomes a rotating disc with a centre hub.
It can sit beside the track details or the existing lyrics view.

The ordinary album cover remains the default. Your choice is remembered locally.
Rotation stops when paused, buffering or hidden, and respects reduced motion.
The existing audio element, output selection, queue and Gapless Playback are unchanged.
See the [illustrated playback guide](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/wiki/Playback-and-queue#optional-cd-view).

## Clearer navigation and player controls

- Long translated sidebar labels wrap without a horizontal scrollbar; compact History
  labels leave more room for navigation and collection counts.
- Sidebar shortcuts use soft edge fades to show where more items follow. Wheel,
  trackpad and keyboard navigation remain available. Small windows keep their existing
  mobile menu; system high-contrast mode retains native scrollbars.
- The page scrollbar appears while the pointer is over the content and remains visible
  while dragging. Other scrollable panels, lyrics and dialogs retain their native bars.
  Unsupported browsers and non-hover devices keep the native page scrollbar.
- Native audio controls and the iBroadcast footer logo follow palette contrast,
  improving readability in Light mode, including Apple Music Classic.

## Upgrading and platform notes

Quit older Tagcast instances before opening the update. Existing credentials,
settings, themes and local preferences are retained. Standalone downloads include
Python for macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, Windows x64 and Linux x64. Source/browser
use remains available with Python 3.11+ or uv.

Experimental Gapless Playback remains optional and off by default. Its existing
supported ordered-album transitions and ordinary-playback fallback are unchanged;
this release makes no universal sample-accuracy claim. Linux needs a compatible
graphical desktop and Chromium sandbox support. Do not disable the sandbox.

## Code signing and privacy

The **macOS downloads are Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple**, with
signatures and stapled tickets checked after archive extraction. Windows signing
through SignPath is not yet active; Windows downloads remain unsigned. See the
[Code signing policy](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast#code-signing-policy)
and [Privacy policy](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/blob/v1.4.0/PRIVACY.md).
Tagcast does not retag or modify existing local music files. Language and display
changes do not contact lyrics providers or change your iBroadcast library.
